gaps.explanation: Gap 127,876 (statement 12,594,331, detail 12,466,455) has two parts. (1) MISSING FUND COLUMN 29,993: the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds (p4) prints a 'Leasing Corporation' column (Interest income 17,708 + Other 12,285 = Total revenues 29,993) that has no schedule: the p8 budget schedule is titled 'Governmental Funds (Excluding Debt Service Fund and Leasing Corporation)' and p9 covers only the Debt Service Fund. Added below as one line per printed non-zero row. The same column also prints 'Proceeds from issuance of bonds' 1,860,000 under Other Financing Sources (Uses); that line is added here too (section 'other financing') so the column is complete, but it is NOT part of the revenue arithmetic (there is no other-financing gap row for this report; detail has only the Debt Service Fund's 1,585,000 of the statement's 3,445,000). (2) DIFFERENT BASIS 97,883: the budget schedules print other amounts than the fund statement. p8 (General + Sales Tax + TIF + Keno) prints Total revenues 12,064,875 vs p4 columns 3,872,741 + 2,146,735 + 6,057,411 + 96,604 = 12,173,491 (+108,616): Taxes p8 10,599,337 vs p4 2,502,807 + 2,146,735 + 6,057,411 = 10,706,953 (+107,616); Licenses and permits p8 424,217 vs p4 425,217 (+1,000); all other rows agree (Intergovernmental 554,803, Charges 85,430, Miscellaneous/Other 209,235, Keno 86,798, Grant income 80,456, Interest 14,793 + 9,806 = 24,599). p9 Debt Service Fund prints Total revenues 401,580 vs p4 Bond column 390,847 (-10,733: Taxes p9 390,545 vs p4 379,812; Interest 11,035 agrees). 108,616 - 10,733 = 97,883. Arithmetic: 12,466,455 + 29,993 (revenue adds) = 12,496,448; 12,594,331 - 12,496,448 = 97,883 = the printed budget-basis difference (no detail fix for that part).
